paragraphs: Abba Yosi HaTorati. Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 34, after Rabbi Chiyya Rabbah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Midrash Rabbah -- TE at Bereshit Rabbah 34:10 places Abba Yosi HaTorati’s saying after Rabbi Chiyya Rabbah’s. “After” can therefore describe order in the passage rather than a later generation. The named passage explicitly writes Rabbi Chiyya Rabbah.

Earlier uncertain source readings ההורתי/ההורת׳ remain historical alternatives. The named digital text supports the current contextual התורתי reading, not literal-pixel certainty or correction history. The source’s chapter 34 remains unchanged.
